selected_script.angle: kitchen backsplash sticky grease getting torn paper towel lint stuck to it
selected_script.hook: POV: trying to wipe that sticky grease off your kitchen wall, and now you have torn paper towel stuck to it.

segment_01.voiceover: Trying to clean kitchen wall grease with a dry towel is a nightmare. But then I found NUAN heavy duty degreaser.

segment_02.voiceover: It has a fresh peach scent! Just spray the foam, wait a bit, and wipe it away. The grease melts off instantly without heavy scrubbing.

segment_03.voiceover: It works on stovetops, range hoods, and cookware too. Grab your 500-milliliter bottle today and make kitchen cleanup a breeze.
